content: हृद् {%n.%} (This word has no forms for the first five inflections, and is optionally substituted for हृदय after <ab>acc.</ab> dual) .²1 The mind, heart; त्यक्तं गृहाद्यपि मया भवतापशान्त्यै नासीदसौ हृतहृदो मम मायया ते <ls>Bhagavaccharaṇa S. 15</ls>. .²2 The chest, bosom, breast; इमां हृदि व्यायतपातमक्षिणोत् <ls>Ku. 5. 54</ls>. .²3 The soul. .²4 The interior or essence of anything.
